author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN; photographer not credited)
date_taken: 2026 (CDN Last-Modified 2026-10-22; UFC 333 fight week, Abu Dhabi)
notes: Sharp frontal studio headshot, the best image for eyes, brows, nose and mouth. Long hair slicked straight back off the forehead, light blond-brown stubble, blue-grey eyes. The new Japanese-style tiger tattoo shows on his right upper chest and shoulder.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN; photographer not credited)
notes: Current full-body cutout, front, slight turn to his left. Red shorts with a darker red scalloped pattern, black UFC panel and white grid on the waistband, crypto.com logo. Shows the tiger and cherry-blossom piece over his right chest, shoulder and upper arm, and a red-and-grey element on the right flank under the arm. Best image for current physique.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN; photographer not credited)
notes: Full body, Dec 2024, before the chest and arm tattoo. Black and grey tiger-stripe shorts with white slashes and red VOLKOV lettering. Right chest and arm bare; a red-and-grey piece on the LEFT flank (confirmed on the left in the June 2024 face-off). Waistband logo reads correctly, so the image is not mirrored. Leaner midsection than 2026, faint upper abs.

author: UFC (YouTube still, credited 'Youtube/UFC' by Cageside Press)
notes: Face-off with Rizvan Kuniev, Volkov at left seen from his right side at about 70 degrees. Wet hair slicked back to the nape. Shows the full extent of the new right-side piece: tiger, waves and blossoms over the right shoulder blade, right side of the upper back, right chest and right arm. Most recent photo.

author: Patrick Danna / Cageside Press
notes: Face-off with Waldo Cortes-Acosta, Volkov at left in three-quarter from his right side, smiling. Hair worn loose, shoulder length. Shows the right shoulder-blade part of the back piece (black with red flowers or flames). Cool stage light, desaturated skin.

author: Cageside Press (same UFC 328 ceremonial gallery; frame credited to Patrick Danna on the article lead image)
notes: Clean left profile while flexing: forehead slope, long straight nose, thin lips, long chin, left ear (normal folds), and the long dark-blond hair falling past the collar. Left chest bare; top of the red left-flank piece just visible at the bottom edge.

author: Dave Noseworthy / Cageside Press
notes: Face-off with Jailton Almeida; Volkov in three-quarter from his right. Hair loose, shoulder length, light stubble to short beard. His right shoulder and upper chest are bare here, so the chest/arm part of the tattoo was added between Oct 2025 and Oct 2026.

author: Not credited on the page (UFC 321 media-day still)
notes: Frontal at the media-day table in a beige polo. Long hair loose to the shoulders with a centre part, short beard. Small and soft, useful only for the off-cage look.

author: Getty Images / Zuffa LLC (612 px web copy embedded by LowKick MMA; photographer not named on the page)
